verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-first banking platform with a documented public REST API. It offers a free sandbox with self-serve API keys and HTTP Basic Auth (a `ping` endpoint to test), and endpoint reference pages for accounts, ACH, wires, cards and webhooks. A Postman collection and a machine-readable llms.txt index further support programmatic and agent use. Missing for 10: a publicly retrievable OpenAPI spec (all standard paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end.
